title: Argentinian Skillet Steak
description: A smoky and flavorful Argentinian-inspired dish featuring a skillet-seared steak, served with a side of sautéed onions and bell peppers.
instructions: Season steak with smoky luscious seasoning blend and let sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes.
Sear steak in skillet for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F for medium-rare.
Transfer steak to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
In the same skillet, add olive oil and sauté sliced onions and bell peppers until tender.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve steak with sautéed onions and bell peppers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
